definition: A household can be defined as those who dwell under the same residential roof and compose a family. A household is distinct and should be distinguished from a family because a household does not need to have the same financial, emotional, and social interconnection. However, a family can be a household. Household is defined in Lumbermens Mut. Casualty Co. v. Pulsifer as "a collection of persons as a single group, with one head, living together, a unit of a permanent and domestic character, under one roof: a 'collective body of persons living together within one curtilage, subsisting in common and directing their attention to a common object, the promotion of their mutual interests and social happiness.'" house arrest / household Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 Wex  ACADEMIC TOPICS  legal education and writing  COMMERCE  commercial activities  housing  LIFE EVENTS  family & personal matters  wex definitions  family law  legal education and practice
